verbs.name: edit.eq
verbs.description: Parametric audio EQ on a clip — the audio analog of edit.grade, for cleaning up voice on talking-head / podcast / screen-demo audio. A high-pass (low-cut, removes rumble/HVAC), any number of peaking bands (presence boost, mud/de-ess cut), and a low-pass (high-cut, tames hiss). Two ways to specify: (1) a PRESET (the easy path) — voice (low-cut + de-mud + presence), warmth (low-mid body), de_rumble (subsonic cut), phone (telephone band-limit, a lo-fi effect), de_ess (tame sibilance), brighten (high-end air). (2) RAW high_pass_hz / low_pass_hz / bands[{freq_hz, gain_db, q}]. enabled:false (or an empty/identity EQ) CLEARS it. AUDIO-track media clips only (a video file's audio is a separate clip on its own audio track). Emitted as ffmpeg highpass → equalizer(per band) → lowpass on the clip audio; applies on both the software and GPU render paths (the GPU fast-track reuses the software audio chain).

clip.description: Media clip id (on an audio track)

preset.description: Named EQ shape; resolved to explicit high_pass/low_pass/bands

high_pass_hz.description: High-pass (low-cut) corner frequency, Hz (raw; omit for none)

low_pass_hz.description: Low-pass (high-cut) corner frequency, Hz (raw; omit for none)

bands.description: Peaking bands (raw; ignored when preset is given). A 0 dB band is dropped.

gain_db.description: Boost (+) or cut (-) at the centre, dB

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.
